task.title: Postmortem -> EvolutionDecisionProposal auto-trigger bridge
task.summary_zh: POST-001 + EVO-001 已落地為 schema/service，但 incident/postmortem publish → EvolutionDecisionProposal 自動觸發的 bridge 還沒實際 wire。本任務新增 postmortem_bridge module：訂閱 postmortem published 事件，按 severity 與 corrective_action_required 判斷是否產出 EvolutionDecisionProposal payload（不直接寫 governance store，僅 emit proposal）。獨立 module，不改 POST-001 / EVO-001 公開 API。
acceptance: postmortem_bridge.py exposes on_postmortem_published(postmortem) returning EvolutionDecisionProposal or None
proposal emitted when postmortem.severity in (high critical) or corrective_action_required is true
proposal payload includes source_postmortem_id evidence_refs proposed_action (rollback retrain revalidate redeploy retire) and cooldown_window_hours
bridge never writes to governance store only returns proposal dict for governance to admit
